title: The fraud report doesn't mention immigrants once
body: For over a year, the Trump administration has told you immigrants are draining the healthcare system. The government's own numbers say otherwise. The Intercept reports that the semiannual fraud report from HHS's Office of Inspector General, the one that tracks actual enforcement, doesn't mention immigrants a single time. What it shows is corporations. CEOs billing Medicare for medically unnecessary devices. Executives running Affordable Care Act enrollment scams that preyed on homeless people. The National Health Care Anti-Fraud Association puts the yearly cost as high as $300 billion, most of it providers billing for services never rendered.

While JD Vance and Mehmet Oz warned about "illegal aliens" gaming California's system, Trump was letting the real fraudsters walk. He granted clemency to the owner of a mental health company who got 50 years for a $205 million Medicare scheme. The California governor's office found his pardons erased nearly $2 billion in taxpayer and victim recovery. That same stretch, he froze over $1 billion in Medicaid payments to California and Minnesota, citing the fraud he blames on immigrants.

It's the welfare queen playbook with a new target. Pick a group people already fear, pin the theft on them, then cut the benefits everyone else relies on too. The report names the real thieves. They just don't have anyone to deport.
